reference.title: Understanding the Role of Order in Y-Series Non-Fullerene Solar Cells to Realize High Open-Circuit Voltages

digitization.method: Independent symbol-center read-off from original PDF embedded raster images; coordinate transforms are reproduced in extract_anchors.py. No inferred model-fit curves are represented as measurements.
digitization.uncertainty: Intervals are conservative readout/digitization bounds, not author experimental confidence intervals or standard errors. Unknown systematic calibration uncertainty is additional.
digitization.temperature_uncertainty: Displayed nominal temperatures retained; instrument/calibration uncertainty not reported in the inspected pages.

Fig3a.technique: BACE R versus n, steady-state open circuit
Fig3a.illumination: Variable-intensity445nm laser; no single1sun point identity attached to each selected symbol
Fig3a.coefficient_definition: Local R/n^2 evaluated at3 selected measured squares perT, then median; delta slightly above2 means k2 is approximate/effective
Fig3a.role: Independent validation; retain separately from PIA normalization

Fig4a.technique: Derived recombination order delta and m from BACE; n_id from temperature-dependent JV
Fig4a.fact: No direct k2(T) plot; k2 must be derived from Fig3a

Fig5a.role: Calibration of one global energy offset is permissible; no perT adjustable fit

Fig5b.technique: Extraction-less PIA carrier density at open circuit
Fig5b.density_definition: n in cm^-3, interpreted by authors as equal electron and hole densities n=p; not n+p
Fig5b.calibration_available: Published n-axis values. Exact PM6:Y6 PIA differential-absorption-to-density coefficient and uncertainty are not supplied in the inspected main/SI. PIA instrument sensitivity1e-7 does not establish absolute n calibration.
Fig5b.caution: SI S6 uses1.25eV probe and an Ag-reflection correction for PM6:N4. Do not transfer that calibration to PM6:Y6 without evidence.
Fig5b.role: Calibration n(T) anchors; do not claim low-T BACE measurement

FigS15a.technique: Dark symbols and1sun-equivalent white-light JV solid lines
FigS15a.intermediate_temperatures: Unlabelled trace sequence;150/200/250K are not assigned.
FigS15a.current: Logarithmic magnitude axis in mA cm^-2. Signed JV cannot be uniquely reconstructed from the plotted magnitude.
FigS15a.role: Sparse endpoint transport/leakage validation, not full multiT JV fit

FigS16a.role: All27 lower-intensity points are held out. Nine1sun points duplicate Fig5 and are not independent validation.
FigS16a.author_prediction: n(T,I)=n(T,1sun)*sqrt(I/I1sun), assuming bimolecular recombination at allT. Fits derived at1sun.

cross_figure_warning.same_exact_device_and_absorbed_generatio: Not established. Same material and nominal architecture do not imply same optical excitation, area, cathode or identical sample.
cross_figure_warning.observed_mismatch: Fig3a apparent300K coefficient median2.10e-11cm3/s versus explicit Fig1 RTapproximately8e-12; factor2.63. Fig3 k200/k300 approximately.0458 while constant-G Fig5b inverse-density-squared ratio approximately.1445. The differences exceed assigned readout bounds.
cross_figure_warning.consequence: Keep Fig1,Fig3,Fig5 as separate-condition evidence. Report joint-model residuals and uncertainty; do not silently rescale data, add arbitrary perT parameters, claim extraction error in the paper, or assert independently measured G(T).

unidentified_inputs: Exact absolute PIA cross-section and its temperature dependence for these PM6:Y6 samples
Exact intermediate S15 trace temperature map
Contact work functions, injection barriers, surface recombination velocities for quantitative boundary conditions
Independent experimental uncertainty/covariance for digitized curves

source_issue.S1c: SI physical p12 actually prints positive exponent in mu0(T)=muinf*exp[(2sigma/(3kBT))^2]. QA.md confirms missing minus sign is in the original PDF, not OCR. Using the standard negative exponent is an explicit correction/model choice, not literal transcription.
